notes.federationPackage: Confirmed absent, not merely unchecked: no `@pr-federation/react` dependency in server/frontend/package.json, and no import of it anywhere under server/frontend/src. spiderweb-pr is the one repo in the PRII family that does not consume the shared design package.
notes.shadcn: Confirmed absent: no components.json anywhere in the repo, no shadcn/ui-generated files under server/frontend/src/components. All controls are hand-written.
notes.styling: Two hand-written stylesheets: server/frontend/src/styles/federation.css (design tokens — colors, fonts, spacing, focus-visible ring, --fd-* namespace, light/dark palettes) and server/frontend/src/styles/app.css (component-level rules built on top of those tokens: .act, .navbtn, .tab, .badge, .pill, .empty-state, etc.). server/frontend/src/styles/tokens.css is a thin legacy alias layer mapping old --x names onto the canonical --fd-x tokens.

controlSourceMap.button: hand-written; no shared <Button> component — every caller renders a native <button> styled by a utility class. Primary variants: `.act` / `.act.primary` (styles/app.css:151-152, e.g. RUN PIPELINE, EXPORT CSV/BRIEF), `.navbtn` (styles/app.css:100-106, left-rail nav/source/watchlist rows), `.tab` (styles/app.css:110-116, tab strip). All inherit the global focus-visible ring from styles/federation.css:90-93.
controlSourceMap.dialog: none present — no <dialog> element, no modal/overlay component anywhere in server/frontend/src (grep for dialog|Dialog|modal|Modal in .tsx/.css returned zero component matches). The closest analog is the always-visible, non-overlay Inspector side panel (server/frontend/src/components/Inspector.tsx, InspectorShell.tsx, styled by .inspector/.panel-head in styles/app.css:119-125), which renders inline in the persistent 3-column layout rather than as a dismissible dialog.
controlSourceMap.badge: hand-written, server/frontend/src/components/Badges.tsx — TierBadge, Pill, ConfidenceMeter, AnomalyScore, ContradictionFlag. Styled via `.badge` and `.pill[data-tone]` in styles/app.css:153-161, plus `.navbtn[data-status]` status-color rules at styles/app.css:205-206.
controlSourceMap.toggle: no dedicated Toggle/Switch component — every toggle is a plain <button aria-pressed> or a button with a data-on/data-active attribute. Examples: theme toggle (components/CommandBar.tsx, '◐ LIGHT'/'◑ DARK'), STUB/RAG LIVE toggle (modules/QueryLayer.tsx), 8 layer toggles (modules/SpatialIntelligence.tsx). Styled via `.act[data-on="true"]` and `.navbtn[data-active="true"]` in styles/app.css:151-152/101.
controlSourceMap.empty-state: hand-written, `.empty-state` / `.empty-state[data-tone="error"]` in styles/app.css:178-179. Used in components/RailSection.tsx, components/EntityLinkList.tsx, modules/InvestigationGraph.tsx, modules/AnomalyWorkbench.tsx, and the Inspector's 'No selection' default state in App.tsx.

themeSupport.details: Full light/dark theme support via a `[data-theme]` attribute on <html>, defined in styles/federation.css (light values on :root, dark overrides under [data-theme="dark"]). A visible toggle button in the command bar (components/CommandBar.tsx, theme.ts) flips it and persists the choice to localStorage['spiderweb_theme']; on first load with no stored preference it seeds from prefers-color-scheme. Live-verified: clicking the toggle flipped document.documentElement.dataset.theme from 'light' to 'dark' and re-rendered the whole chrome (see theme-dark-desktop-1280x800.png).
